name: Five-Trading-Day Pre-Earnings Blackout
known_limitations: Lite has no verified earnings-calendar source/known-at or gate runtime.
notes: Legacy six-gates-production-v1 is selected active V1; this Lite artifact is review-required knowledge only. Unresolved blackout config or missing/future-verified earnings schedule => INSUFFICIENT_DATA for new/add/rotation context.

details.purpose: Prevent fresh/add/rotation entry inside verified pre-earnings blackout while allowing existing-position management.

pass_condition.description: Existing-position hold/reduce/exit/risk-management is not prohibited by this gate. For fresh/add/rotation, verified schedule is outside five trading sessions before earnings.

fail_condition.description: For fresh/add/rotation, verified future earnings date is within <=5 exchange trading sessions.

details.score_interaction: Independent event admissibility; high score or LLM cannot override FAIL.
details.strategy_interaction: Does not force exits or create an entry strategy.
details.portfolio_context: Existing risk management remains allowed by this gate alone.
